source: Shade card data .xlsx — Products Master export (1610 rows) with the Shade Card number / date columns filled by hand
notes: 906 of 1610 products carry a shade card number; 859 also carry a date, 47 are number-only.
The 906 products resolve to 599 distinct physical cards — 112 of those serve more than one customer, so a card is NOT per-customer.
34 cards carry different dates on different products. The LATEST date wins (agreed 2026-07-28): a card is only as old as its most recent approval.
SW-323 and SW-1063 (card CI0740) read 31-02-2024, which is not a real date. Corrected to 2024-02-29 — 2024 was a leap year, so this is the month end that was meant.
Product codes here are the codes as they stood on 2026-07-28 BEFORE the dedup + renumber wave. Run this import first; the renumber invalidates these keys.
